name: Ana Carballar
bio: Student in the Bachelor’s Degree in Cinematography at the National School of Cinematographic Arts (ENAC) of the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM). She entered the degree program in 2023; she is currently in her seventh semester and is in the specialization area in fiction filmmaking.

credits.title: What's Left Behind
credits.overview: After his wife's death, Jacinto returns to the home he shared with her; consumed by her absence, a presence manifests, forcing him to confront her memory and bid her farewell.

credits.title: One Night
credits.overview: At Ana's quinceañera party, her chambelán, Mauricio, aims to confess his love after facing a series of obstacles that will make him second-guess his decision.

credits.title: Manual for (un) Inhabiting a Body
credits.overview: A film essay based on the reappropriation of family photographs and videos that explores the relationship between images, the memories created from them, the words we are called by, and the gender roles assigned to us.
